result.description: Marketing automation platform for email, SMS and customer data/profiles, with flows, campaigns, lists and segments.
result.auth_detail: Private API key (scoped, per-account, user-created, server-side), OAuth2 (auth code + PKCE, for partner apps), and public key (company ID) for client-side endpoints only.
result.access_detail: Each end user can create a scoped private API key in their own account, with no review, and Klaviyo has a free plan. For OAuth, an unreviewed app can still be installed by any customer; Klaviyo shows a warning until the app is approved. The 5-install and security-review requirements apply only to App Marketplace listing, not to connecting accounts. I did not verify that API access is available on the free plan, so paid_plan is not fully ruled out; this is likely but not confirmed.
result.api_notes: JSON:API-style REST with dated revisions (current 2026-10-15) and an OpenAPI spec. Covers profiles, events, lists, segments, campaigns, flows, templates, catalogs, metrics, coupons, reviews and more. The Conversations API is gated.

evidence.quote: Klaviyo provides 3 methods of authentication including private key authentication and OAuth (used to call server-side APIs) and public key authentication (used to call client-side APIs).
While customers and testers can still install and use your app, having your app approved by Klaviyo will remove this warning and allow for easy discoverability within the App Marketplace.
Private API keys can be used to read and write data to your Klaviyo account.
